(Japanese: '''アカネ色のイーブイ''' ''Akane-Colored {{tt|Eievui|Eevee}}'') is the fourth chapter of the [[How I Became a Pokémon Card]] manga.

{{Spoilers}}

==Plot==
{{HIBAPC|Akane}} is annoyed by her {{p|Eevee}} that keeps following her. After giving it to [[Team Rocket]] however, she goes and tries to rescue it. Later, her grandpa tells her about how Eevee cheered her up when she was a baby. After that, Akane and Eevee's relationship improves.

==Major events==
* {{HIBAPC|Akane}} gives her {{p|Eevee}} to [[Team Rocket]].
* Akane rescues her Eevee.

==Characters==
===Humans===
* {{HIBAPC|Akane}}
* Akane's grandfather
* {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}
* Manager

===Pokémon===
* {{p|Eevee}} (Akane's)
* {{p|Hitmonlee}} ({{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}'s)
* {{p|Clefairy}} (manager's)
* {{p|Meowth}} (manager's)
* {{p|Nidoran♂}} (manager's)

==Trivia==
* Based on the design of the mansion and the appearance of the hidden passageway in the city's Game Corner, this story most likely takes place in [[Celadon City]].
